reviewed_slice.slice: P1-c 退路实现与 DeviceCaps.fallbacks 双路

combination.layer: selection (select_native returns bool, no error channel)

observation.title: combination rule wording mixes two layers
observation.detail: README §4 'any combination of the 12 flags never returns DeviceError::Unsupported' holds at the selection layer (select_native returns bool, no error channel); the CUDA adapter still returns Unsupported when a flag is true but the native path is unimplemented (K.1 native-capture, B.11 native-zero-copy). Defaults are false so the default device does not hit it. Suggest splitting selection-layer rule vs adapter-layer unsupported.

observation.title: K.1 fallback double-records the trace
observation.detail: CudaQueue::capture calls graph_mode() (records 1) then capture_sequential() (records 1 more) -> 2 GraphCapture entries per capture; trace-count-based judgments would over-count.

observation.title: B.11 fallback performs a blocking DtoD copy
observation.detail: CUDA borrow_external Copy path uses memcpy_dtod_sync (blocking) and usize::try_from(bytes).unwrap_or(usize::MAX); evidence only says 'no wait_idle', does not mention the blocking copy.
observation.remediation: errata: state synchronous DtoD in fallback semantics

observation.title: B.10 CUDA pool is take-only and byte_len uses slot capacity
observation.detail: transient fallback swap_removes a slot and never returns it (no release API); returned buffer byte_len = pooled capacity (>= requested), inconsistent with alloc semantics.
observation.remediation: errata: note P1-c simplification, pooling in P2

observation.title: H.1 'dual path' shares one implementation
observation.detail: native_add and cas_loop_add both run the same CAS loop; retry_loop only documents the distinction. Device-side native belongs to P2.

observation.title: 4 of 10 items are selection-only (cfg(test)) in the CUDA adapter
observation.detail: K.2/K.3/C.1/H.1 CUDA selection helpers are #[cfg(test)]; product builds have no wiring for them. README §3/§6 disclose 'selection frozen only, device-side execution is P2', so if the acceptance bar is 'all 10 reachable in product code' these 4 do not meet it.
observation.remediation: Chief ruling: unify wording as '10/12 = selection-layer implementation; 6 product-wired (B.10/B.11/G.9/K.1/K.5/L.3), 4 (K.2/K.3/C.1/H.1) selection-only in tests with device-side execution deferred to P2'; no rework; P1-c evidence wording to be adjusted by Backend in P2-b first commit; P2-b scope extended to D.4/D.10 + K.2/K.3/C.1/H.1 device-side execution
